verses.text: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.

xrefs.text: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

verses.text: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.

xrefs.text: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—

verses.text: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.

xrefs.text: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.

verses.text: As for the deeds of men— by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.

xrefs.text: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
“Away from Me, Satan! Jesus told him. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’

verses.text: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.

xrefs.text: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.

verses.text: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.

xrefs.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.

verses.text: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.

xrefs.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.

verses.text: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings

xrefs.text: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
Keep my commandments and live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

verses.text: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

xrefs.text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

verses.text: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.

xrefs.text: Do not boast so proudly, or let arrogance come from your mouth, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by Him actions are weighed.
May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.

For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.

verses.text: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,

xrefs.text: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

Saul was proceeding along one side of the mountain, and David and his men along the other side. Even though David was hurrying to get away, Saul and his men were closing in on David and his men to capture them.
All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.

verses.text: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.

xrefs.text: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.

verses.text: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,

xrefs.text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.

verses.text: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.

xrefs.text: But it was He who filled their houses with good things; so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!
If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.

verses.text: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.

xrefs.text: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
